description: This file defines the internal class 'GrainDirectoryPartition' which manages a partition of the distributed grain directory in Orleans. It includes methods for snapshot management, range locking, membership updates, and inter-silo communication, with detailed logging and debugging support.

classes.name: PartitionSnapshotState
classes.description: Represents the state of a snapshot transfer, including the version, addresses, and transfer partners.

methods.name: CreateGrainId
methods.description: Creates a unique GrainId for the partition based on silo address and partition index.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the current view of the membership snapshot asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the partition for a given range and version.

methods.name: AcknowledgeSnapshotTransferAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a snapshot transfer from another silo.

methods.name: RemoveSnapshotTransferPartner
methods.description: Removes a transfer partner from the snapshot transfer list.

methods.name: WaitForRange
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a range to be unlocked for a specific version.

methods.name: GetPartitionReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to another partition on a specified silo.

methods.name: OnShuttingDown
methods.description: Handles shutdown procedures for the partition.

methods.name: OnSiloRemovedFromCluster
methods.description: Handles the event when a silo is removed from the cluster.

methods.name: OnRecoveringPartition
methods.description: Handles the recovery process for a partition.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to the cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: CheckIntegrityAsync
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the directory's internal state for consistency.
